meaning: The dynamic external pressure input is built as a staircase of three levels whose transitions are smoothed by a quintic smoothstep over a fixed duration `dur`. This makes P_ext continuous with zero first and second derivative at each step edge, instead of a jump.

could_move.what: Shape and timing of every jugular-compression onset/release transient, since the deck drives P_ext through this function
Stiffness of the ODE and thus solver step choice; a softened edge changes what dtmax is adequate
Fitted parameter values, because the fit sees the smoothed ramp rather than the recorded pressure edge
The h-sweep families over P_ext, where the transition width interacts with the swept amplitude

expectation: Peaks and slopes during each transition are reduced and delayed relative to a step input; the effect grows with `dur` and should vanish as `dur` goes to zero. Steady levels between transitions should be unaffected. Magnitude unknown from the code alone.

check.why: Re-runs one fitted case without a full re-fit, so the transient shape and residuals under the current smoothstep can be inspected directly.
